cohort: Nulliparous Japanese women with singleton gestation, who went into labor at term at Osaka Women's and Children's Hospital from January 2015 to December 2017
finding: Shorter nulliparous Japanese women were more likely to undergo cesarean delivery, but there were no significant differences in rates of other delivery modes or maternal and neonatal morbidities based on maternal height.
mod_finding: Shorter nulliparous Japanese women were more likely to undergo cesarean delivery.
